i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Goal: resolve the scope, priority, and acceptance shape of issue 211 — calibration by task/evidence mode/module family. Context loaded: issue text, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, architecture index, engine-config. Note: user says refactor is in progress; file paths may shift. Record pass when loaded.

q1.title: What does the current calibration code look like?
q1.imperative: Ask the user: Is the current global calibration a single covariance scale applied at fusion, or does it live somewhere else (e.g. temperature scaling post-fusion, per-module weight)? Recommend: fusion.py precision-weighted composition with a global scale.

q2.title: Which calibration dimension is the highest priority?
q2.imperative: Ask: Of task (quali/race_start/race), evidence mode (recent_history vs race_weekend), and module family (driver vs constructor) — which dimension do you want this issue to focus on first? Recommend: task-split, since it has the clearest boundary and the acceptance criteria mention it.

q3.title: Diagnostic only, or does this issue also ship a new calibration scheme?
q3.imperative: Ask: The acceptance criteria say 'compare current against at least one more specific scheme' and 'do not replace unless metrics improve.' Does this issue ship a switchable calibration scheme (even off by default), or only diagnostics + a written recommendation? Recommend: diagnostics + comparison report; no permanent scheme change unless metrics clearly win.

q4.title: Where do the diagnostics land — gold cycle artifact or standalone script?
q4.imperative: Ask: Should the calibration diagnostics by task/module-family be wired into the gold cycle (so they appear in every gold run), or is a standalone backtest/diagnostic script acceptable for now? Recommend: gold cycle sidecar if compact enough; standalone script if the gold cycle is already complex.

status_detail.reason: same answer as q3 — stays gold-cycle artifact, same delivery point as task_calibration already uses

q5.title: How does the in-progress refactor affect this work?
q5.imperative: Ask: What is the refactor touching — module boundaries, gold cycle orchestration, report schemas, or something else? The plan needs to know which files are stable enough to build on and which are moving targets.

triage_candidates.statement: Fusion assumes module independence but correlated modules (shared inputs) inflate effective precision. Near-term: compute pairwise rank-error correlations from existing event_level_metrics, use as basis for de-weighting correlated module pairs in fusion. Requires new artifact + fusion contract change. Separate issue.
